covers: Aber v1.0.0 to v1.7.0 were all built on this base, so this release covers every one of their database images already on GHCR, and every later release built on the same base.

assets.note: The release archive; the base image's build fetched this file.

GitHub's archive of the v3.4.1 tag, which the base image's build fetched. The Nix derivation's hash (sha256-QC77AnPGpPQGEWi6JtJdiNsB2su5+aV2pKg5ImR2B0k=) is over the unpacked tree, so the archive's own bytes are pinned here; its unpacked tree has that NAR hash.
